no_abstract_passed_on_trust.description: NOT rejected: source gave no abstract, so the LNP-focus text check was skipped and the paper was trusted through to the quant/kinetic gates (it still had to pass those to survive).

not_lnp_focused.description: Rejected: had an abstract, but abstract/title/journal text never mentions LNPs specifically

failed_quant_filter.description: Rejected: no quantitative evidence found (even after caption/supplementary rescue)

failed_kinetic_filter.description: Rejected: no time-course/kinetic evidence found (strict_kinetic step, even after rescue)

llm_excluded.description: Rejected: passed all regex gates, but the LLM judged it off-topic/irrelevant
